desc: Brothers mode online on a relay room: Luigi looks on each screen as he moves. The host walks Mario right and left, stops, hops and takes a running jump (Luigi following: the guest sees the host's Luigi), then the guest takes Luigi and walks, stops, turns and hops him (the host sees the guest's), then the host walks out the east door. Every game checks each Luigi and partner it draws (TTYD_LOOK_CHECK: its own, the other game's; Mario's ghost is as the host's own Mario, who walks in place a moment where walk_to steers him along a wall): never walking in place, never sliding while standing, his paper turned the way he goes

log_must: co-op: seat 2's character walked by player 2's own game
co-op: this guest walks its own character \(seat 2\)
